webTabsPlaceholder.title: Web Tabs
webTabsPlaceholder.description: Embed external URLs as tabs and keep referenced apps a click away from your records.

globalSetsPlaceholder.title: Global Sets
globalSetsPlaceholder.description: Define reusable picklist values once and share them across modules to keep dropdowns consistent.

globalSets.title: Global Sets
globalSets.description: Reusable pick list values shared by pick list fields across modules. Edit a set once and every linked field follows.
globalSets.empty: No global sets yet. Create one to share pick list values across modules.
globalSets.noMatches: No global set matches your search.
globalSets.noAccess: You don't have permission to view global sets.

editor.name: Global set name
editor.pendingUnused: On save, these values move to Unused Values (records keep them): {{values}}
editor.saveFirst: Save or cancel your changes to replace values or move unused values back.

replace.title: Replace a value
replace.help: Records of every linked field holding the value are moved to its replacement, and the old value moves to Unused Values.
replace.tooManyFields: This set is used by {{count}} fields. Values cannot be replaced while a set is used by more than {{limit}} fields.

usedIn.title: Used In
usedIn.none: No field uses this global set yet.
usedIn.reportsNotTracked: Reports that filter on these fields are not listed here yet.
usedIn.reportsUnavailable: Reports could not be checked for this field.

delete.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
delete.message: The global set will be deleted.
delete.messageLinked_one: The global set will be deleted. The {{count}} field using it keeps its current values as its own list.
delete.messageLinked_other: The global set will be deleted. The {{count}} fields using it keep their current values as their own lists.
delete.tooManyFields: Used by {{count}} fields — a set used by more than {{limit}} fields cannot be deleted.

associate.title: Associate Picklist with Global Set
associate.help: Each value of this field is matched to a value of the set. Records holding a value mapped to another one are updated; a value moved to unused stays on its records.
associate.noPlaces: No custom view or workflow uses this field.

field.title: Global set
field.linked: Values come from the global set "{{name}}". Edit them under Modules and Fields → Global Sets.
field.notLinked: This field uses its own values.
field.convertHelp: The values of this field become a new global set, and the field uses it.

toast.restored: Values moved back to used values
toast.disassociated: Field disassociated; it keeps its current values
toast.converted: Global set "{{name}}" created from the field
toast.workflowNotSynced: Workflow rules could not be updated; rules that name the old value keep it.

errors.duplicateLabel: Two values cannot have the same name.
errors.batchLimit: At most {{count}} values can be moved at a time.

toolbar.createDisabledNoTeamspace: You need at least one teamspace to create a module.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteConfirm.message: This permanently deletes the module along with its fields and layouts, and removes it from every teamspace. A module that still has records can't be deleted — delete its records first. This cannot be undone. Its records, saved views and blueprints in the Recycle Bin are deleted with it, and the module itself is not kept there.
deleteConfirm.hasRecordsError: {{name}} still has records. Delete its records first, then delete the module.

recordVisibility.label: Record visibility
recordVisibility.publicHint: Everyone with module access sees all records.
recordVisibility.hierarchyHint: Users see their own records and those of the users below them: lower-ranked users in their own org unit and its sub-units (Role-based), or the users who report to them (Reporting-based). Unassigned records are visible to everyone. Admins see all.
recordVisibility.publicReadOnlyHint: Users see every record but can only edit their own and their subordinates'.

desk.publicHint: Users can view, modify, and delete all records.
desk.publicReadOnlyHint: Users can view all records. But they can modify and delete only the records owned by themselves and their subordinate roles.
desk.hierarchyHint: Users can view, modify, and delete only the records owned by themselves and their subordinate roles. Unassigned records stay visible to everyone.

status.hasDependencies: This module has dependencies and cannot be disabled.

linkModal.linkDescription: Select teamspaces to link "{{name}}" to. The module will appear in their sidebar without duplicating data.
linkModal.unlinkDescription: Select teamspaces to unlink "{{name}}" from. Its home teamspace can't be unlinked here — delete the module instead.
linkModal.noneAvailable: This module is already linked to every teamspace you can access.
linkModal.noneLinked: This module isn't linked to any other teamspace.
linkModal.errorDefault: The request failed. Please try again.

storageScope.label: Module Data Storage
storageScope.organizationHint: Records are stored once for the whole organization.
storageScope.departmentHint: Each department keeps its own records of this module.
storageScope.immutableHint: The storage level cannot be changed after the module is created.

permissions.label: Module Permission
permissions.hint: Profiles that can open this module. Leave empty to keep the default visibility.

fields.systemFieldLocked: System field — locked to Read Only
fields.requiredBlocksReadOnly: Required field: it can't be Read Only for a profile, because that profile's users could never fill it in. Make it optional or give it an auto-fill rule first.
fields.requiredBlocksHidden: Required field: it can't be hidden from a profile unless it has a default value or an auto-fill rule.

layouts.hint: Design your own layouts to fit your business processes, then assign them to your user accounts based on permission profiles.

deleteConfirm.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteConfirm.description: This permanently deletes the layout and its access settings. This action cannot be undone. Deleted layouts are not kept in the Recycle Bin.

layouts.defaultBadgeTitle: New records use this layout unless another one is chosen.
layouts.setDefaultInactive: Only an active layout can be the default. Enable it first.
layouts.defaultCannotDisable: This is the default layout and cannot be switched off. Set another layout as the default first.
layouts.defaultCannotDelete: This is the default layout for the module and cannot be deleted. Set another layout as the default first.

properties.title: Layout properties — {{name}}
properties.departmentsHint: Records of these departments use this layout. A department can use several layouts of this module; tick Default to make this the layout Add Ticket opens on for that department.
properties.defaultFor: Make this the default layout of {{department}}
properties.pickedNone: No departments picked — every department can use this layout.
properties.nameTooLong: Keep the display name under {{max}} characters.
properties.departmentTaken: One of these departments already uses another layout of this module.
properties.allowNonDepartmentAgents: Allow agents outside these departments to use this layout

standardModule.deleteRefused: "{{name}}" is a standard module, so it can't be deleted.

versionConflict.moduleTitle: This module was changed by someone else
versionConflict.moduleMessage: Another admin saved this module after you opened it, so your change was not saved. Reload to see their version, or overwrite it with yours.
versionConflict.layoutTitle: This layout was changed by someone else
versionConflict.layoutMessage: Another admin saved this layout after you opened it, so your change was not saved. Reload to see their version, or overwrite it with yours.
versionConflict.moduleStatusReloaded: This module was changed by someone else, so its status was not changed. The list is up to date now — try again.
versionConflict.layoutStatusReloaded: This layout was changed by someone else, so its status was not changed. The list is up to date now — try again.
